# Playwright Worker Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.playwright-worker` |
| Source | `09_docker/playwright-worker.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, document |

Playwright browser worker for rendering and scraping web pages as part of the
document ingestion pipeline. Built from the official Playwright Python image.
